# Archival Dispatch: 14 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Knute Rockne Locker Room Pep Talk, Baby Snooks, Lassie, and Duke Ellington

**Date**: 2026-08-21  
**Author**: radio index  
**Tags**: Knute Rockne, Great Moments in Sports, Baby Snooks, Fanny Brice, Hanley Stafford, Lassie, Duke Ellington, The Genius of Duke, Billy Taylor, Nelson Eddy, David Rose, Checkerboard Time, Anson Weeks, Crisco's Radio Newspaper, Lest We Forget, Al Smith, Original Filenames

---

## Batch 91 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 91 recovers and dates 14 historical recordings spanning college football lore, peak golden age domestic comedy, beloved canine adventure serials, jazz history retrospective analysis, symphonic Christmas celebrations, orchestral pop arrangements, and depression-era dance remotes: the legendary 1930 locker room recording of Notre Dame head coach Knute Rockne giving his immortal 'Inside and Outside' pep talk on ***Great Moments in Sports***, 3 classic comedy broadcasts of Fanny Brice and Hanley Stafford on ***The Baby Snooks Show*** (CBS / General Foods, early 1946), 2 broadcasts of the original radio drama ***Lassie*** (ABC / Red Heart Dog Food, 1947), Dr. Billy Taylor and Hal Jackson analyzing Duke Ellington's suite compositions on ***The Genius of Duke*** (1968), baritone Nelson Eddy singing 'Silent Night' and the 'Hallelujah Chorus' with Robert Armbruster's concert orchestra (1945), David Rose's lush strings playing 'The Continental' (1949), Chick Martin's rural music on ***Checkerboard Time*** (1941), Anson Weeks from the Mark Hopkins Hotel (1933), Durward Kirby on ***Crisco's Radio Newspaper*** (1944), and a dramatic civil rights biography of NY Governor Al Smith on ***Lest We Forget*** (1948).
